patch_description:
This version replaces continuously jittering adaptive gains with hysteretic discrete tracking modes. A robust multi-scale, endpoint-aligned regression produces a low-lag measurement and trend estimate. The causal tracker remains in a conservative noise/flat mode until two consecutive high-confidence trend windows are observed, while it requires several low-confidence windows before leaving trend mode.

Confirmed reversals require persistent counter-direction slope evidence, reducing noise-induced output direction changes. During confirmed trends, gains are increased moderately to retain responsiveness and reduce lag. Innovation gating, robust clipping, and velocity deadbands limit outlier influence and false reversals without adding non-causal delay.
